notes.title: Big Bugfix Update is Here!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Huge thanks to all of you who supported [i]Lord Ambermaze[/i] at launch, shared your comments and reviews, and reported bugs. Thanks to you, we’ve got more work to do — and we’ve prepared our very first big bugfix update.[/p][p][/p][p]Update the game, play, and don’t forget to leave a review if you haven’t yet![/p][p][/p][p][b]Here’s what we fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bug where the Mushroom Minion during the Lava Kraken boss fight stopped reacting to sword hits and didn’t spawn lava tiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where buying Fried Chicken at Blu’s shop didn’t restore HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where the game froze when a mob appeared during the Robo-Beetle boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where the bottom border of some rooms was cut off on the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where controls froze during the Lord boss fight when stone walls reappeared.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where using the “Piercing Shot” perk on spiked balls caused the game to freeze.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where certain modifier statues became inactive too early.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where Robo-Beetle’s minions didn’t disappear after his death.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where a Robo-Beetle minion could become invulnerable if a stalactite fell on it.
Bug where the Rufa statue granting +2 to shots didn’t work.
Bug that prevented players from receiving the final achievements![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blocker when buying mana from Blu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple texture bugs.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Text and localization fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect intro credits starting in the wrong languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect description of the Vampirism Potion in English.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect description of Zeus’s Ring in French.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect description of the Wind Gust Potion in German.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken dialogues with Diggeria.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous typos in cutscenes and dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous typos in Rufa’s statue and artifact descriptions.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reworked the final boss and his wave patterns.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the logic in trials where you must attack only with a sword — using the shield is no longer counted as a failure, since it’s defensive, not offensive.
[/p][/*][/list][p]And one more thing: Rufa has lost her levitation powers and no longer floats in the middle of a chasm in some of the colored puzzle rooms.[/p][p][/p][p]With love,
 The Lord Ambermaze Team[/p][p]
[/p]

tags.bug: Bug where the Mushroom Minion during the Lava Kraken boss fight stopped reacting to sword hits and didn’t spawn lava tiles.
Bug where buying Fried Chicken at Blu’s shop didn’t restore HP.
Bug where the game froze when a mob appeared during the Robo-Beetle boss fight.
Bug where the bottom border of some rooms was cut off on the minimap.
Bug where controls froze during the Lord boss fight when stone walls reappeared.
Bug where using the “Piercing Shot” perk on spiked balls caused the game to freeze.
Bug where certain modifier statues became inactive too early.
Bug where Robo-Beetle’s minions didn’t disappear after his death.
Bug where a Robo-Beetle minion could become invulnerable if a stalactite fell on it.
Bug where the Rufa statue granting +2 to shots didn’t work.
Bug that prevented players from receiving the final achievements!
Fixed blocker when buying mana from Blu.
Fixed multiple texture bugs.
Fixed incorrect intro credits starting in the wrong languages.
Fixed incorrect description of the Vampirism Potion in English.
Fixed incorrect description of Zeus’s Ring in French.
Fixed incorrect description of the Wind Gust Potion in German.
Fixed broken dialogues with Diggeria.
Fixed numerous typos in cutscenes and dialogues.
Fixed numerous typos in Rufa’s statue and artifact descriptions.

tags.feature: Reworked the final boss and his wave patterns.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the logic in trials where you must attack only with a sword — using the shield is no longer counted as a failure, since it’s defensive, not offensive.

tags.bug: Rufa has lost her levitation powers and no longer floats in the middle of a chasm in some of the colored puzzle rooms.

notes.title: Bugs, Love, and Shell Games: What’s New in Lord Ambermaze
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

You’ve already taken a peek at our mysterious new acid biome — now it’s time to meet the creature that calls it home. And no, it’s not a cuddly slime...

Introducing: [b]the Robo-Bug [/b]— a terrifying fusion of metal, darkness, and the twisted experiments of the Dark Lord.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Ngkcd39B/Lord-3.gif[/img]

Half machine, half... yep, you guessed it — beetle. A hulking monstrosity with lasers tucked under its shell, ready to test your reflexes (and patience). Don’t worry — dying is almost fun!

But that’s not all — we’ve packed in a bunch of new mini-games to makeZeyn’s adventure even more exciting.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KckDFkCt/LA-chests.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Feel lucky? Try your hand at the classic shell game and see if you can score some treasure.
[*] Can you escape a pitch-black room with nothing but your instincts?
[*] Solve color puzzles or push some crates around in a good old-fashioned [b]sokoban[/b] challenge!
[/list]
After all, you can’t only dodge spikes and fall into pits, right?

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KzyN42Kx/LA-love.gif[/img]

And yes — [b]romance[/b] is in the air!
We’ve added a touch of love to our chaotic world: characters now have charming gift-receiving animations and adorable little hearts floating above their heads. Because even in the darkest dungeons, everyone deserves a little warmth.

Which update caught your eye the most? Let us know in the comments — and don’t forget to add Lord Ambermaze to your Wishlist!
It’s crucial for our survival... as a project, of course. 😅

With love and lasers,
The Lord Ambermaze Team
